title: Keep observations current when the generated knowledge index is rebuilt (#136)
description: Keep observations current when the generated knowledge index is rebuilt (#136)
acceptance_criteria: Rebuilding the knowledge index (chough library index) after recording an observation leaves that observation current: the regression records a passed case observation, confirms current, rebuilds knowledge/INDEX.md (which lists the observation) and confirms it is still current. The configured library-dir name is honored; the legacy fingerprint byte stream is unchanged for older records; .chough/, target/ and SpecSync bookkeeping exclusions behave as before.
